requirement.description: The receive_messages method returns a coroutine instead of an AsyncIterator, causing TypeError when used with 'async for' loops.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be used directly with 'async for' loops. The method should properly yield parsed JSON messages from the subprocess stdout.

requirement.description: The context manager __aexit__ method doesn't properly handle exceptions during disconnection, and some connection cleanup isn't happening correctly.
requirement.contract: The __aexit__ method must ensure proper disconnection even when exceptions occur during the context lifecycle. The disconnect method should be called reliably and handle potential errors gracefully.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method doesn't properly handle the case when stdin is closed after streaming is complete, causing issues with connection management.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method should properly close stdin when streaming is complete, and the transport should maintain proper state for subsequent operations.

requirement.description: Missing proper handling of control protocol responses in the receive_messages method.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must properly handle control protocol responses and maintain the state needed for control requests to work correctly.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method doesn't properly manage the lifecycle of the transport, potentially leaving connections open.
requirement.contract: The process_query method must ensure proper connection and disconnection of the transport, and handle cleanup in all cases including exceptions.
